card.name: In or of before Cambodian place names
card.fires_on: The small words "in" or "of" right before a Cambodian place name (commune, district, province, village), mostly in human-rights reports about killings and evictions.

modes.label: "in" before a place
modes.description: The word "in" after an event or location, just before a Cambodian commune, village or province.
modes.example: during the eviction of squatters from state land<< in>> Choam Ksan commune, Preah

modes.label: "of" before a province
modes.description: The word "of" after a district or bank noun, leading into a named place.
modes.example: private property in the Kompong Siem District<< of>> Kampong Cham Province. The victim's
